name: Server-Side Request Forgery on webhook registration

input.title: Webhook URL fetcher does not block internal metadata endpoints
input.summary: POST /webhooks accepts a URL and the service GETs it for reachability checks. The fetcher does not block 169.254.169.254 or 127.0.0.1.

attacker.existing_authority: register a webhook pointing to a public URL

input.root_cause: No allowlist / denylist of internal network ranges in the URL fetcher

rationale: Classic SSRF to cloud metadata service. Boundary sentence fillable: actor who could previously only register webhooks pointing to public endpoints can now retrieve instance metadata.
